# Shockwave Innovations

> A comprehensive startup fundraising and venture advisory platform providing early-stage founders with strategic guidance, resources, and education for Series A success.

Shockwave Innovations is led by Gordon Daugherty, a seasoned startup advisor with 15+ years of experience and 1,500+ pitch reviews. The platform combines expert mentorship, educational courses, and practical fundraising tools to help founders navigate venture capital and business growth.

## Key Topics

- Venture Capital
- Series A Fundraising
- Startup Strategy
- Angel Investing
- CEO Leadership
- Founder Resources
- Business Development
- Pitch Strategy
- Cap Tables
- Networking
- Sales Strategy
- Business Growth
- Startup Advice
- Founders Academy
- Gordon Daugherty

## Core Platform

- [Business Startups Advice & Fundraising Advice | Shockwave Innovations](https://shockwaveinnovations.com): Shockwave Innovations homepage offering startup advice, fundraising resources & VC guidance
- [Funding the Early Stages of Your Venture Book - Shockwave Innovations](https://shockwaveinnovations.com/book): Gordon Daugherty's book on early-stage venture fundraising strategy & Series A guidance
- [About Gordon Daugherty - Startup Accelerator & Advisor - Shockwave](https://shockwaveinnovations.com/about): Gordon Daugherty bio: 15-year startup advisor with 1,500+ pitch reviews

## Educational Programs

- [Courses - Shockwave Innovations](https://shockwaveinnovations.com/courses): Founders Academy self-paced courses on startup fundamentals & Series A fundraising
- [Business Startup Advice Blog, Fundraising Tips & Growth of a Startup](https://shockwaveinnovations.com/blog): Blog featuring startup advice, fundraising tips & growth strategies from Gordon Daugherty

## Founder Resources & Tools

- [Online Startups Fundraising Resources for Entrepreneurs](https://shockwaveinnovations.com/resources): Startup templates, guides & tools for fundraising, cap tables & pitch preparation
